preconditions.description: The input string s has length between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase English letters.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= len(s) for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: For every query (l, r), the indices satisfy 1 <= l <= r <= |s|.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == sum(z_val(substring, k) for k in range(len(substring))) for i, (l, r) in enumerate(queries) if (substring := s[l-1:r]))
postconditions.description: For each query i with range [l, r], the output line i is the sum of the Z-function values of the substring s[l-1:r], where z_k is the length of the longest common prefix between the substring and its suffix starting at index k (0-based relative to the substring).
